retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1950s-style album cover featuring a full-length female figure in a yellow mermaid gown against a solid red background with bold, stacked condensed typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, two-tone composition featuring a female vocalist in a voluminous yellow gown positioned on the left, balanced by large-scale, right-aligned condensed sans-serif text in yellow and white against a saturated red field.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in yellow gown contrasting against a solid red field
Stacked typography on the right balancing the figure on the left
Primary color palette of red, yellow, and white
Vertical emphasis through condensed fonts and a slender dress silhouette
coreInvariants: Mermaid-style gown with ruffled sleeves and hem

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-length figure positioned on the left third of the frame, scaled to nearly the full height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow gown acts as the primary anchor, drawing the eye before it moves to the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows the curve of the yellow dress down, then moves right to the stacked title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The solid red background provides significant negative space around the head and between the subject and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all elements creates a bold, energetic 'Technicolor' feel.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly red, yellow, white, and black

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is simplified and condensed to match the font width
G has a small, high crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Color-coded hierarchy using the same font family in different colors (yellow for name, white for title).

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel
Classic condensed sans-serif with clean terminals

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body photo of a woman in a bright yellow mermaid-style gown with ruffled sleeves and a flared ruffled hem, standing against a solid, vibrant red background. Position her on the left side of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed sans-serif text in the right half of the frame. The top two lines should be yellow and the bottom three lines should be white, all in uppercase and left-aligned relative to each other.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, saturated red?
Is the dress a bright, contrasting yellow?
Is the text ultra-condensed and uppercase?
Is the layout split between the figure on the left and text on the right?

adjustableVariables: Dress style (can vary as long as it is yellow and voluminous)
mustRedesign: Ensure the subject is not centered
postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleed between red and yellow
Ensure text is perfectly vertical without skew
Verify the subject's pose feels theatrical and mid-century
Confirm the typography is the dominant graphic element on the right
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Yellow, Left) + Background(Red, Solid) + Typography(Condensed, Right-Aligned, Yellow/White Stacked)
